description: The sum() function skips the last array element; fix the loop so all elements are summed.
prompt:
You are fixing a small JavaScript bug.

File: work/swe-01/sum.js

The exported function `sum(arr)` should return the sum of ALL numbers in the array `arr`. Currently it has an off-by-one error: the loop stops before the last element, so `sum([1,2,3])` returns `3` instead of `6`.

Requirements:
- Fix the loop so every element is included.
- `sum([])` must be `0`; single-element, negative, and float arrays must work.
- Keep `module.exports = { sum }` and use no external dependencies.

Edit work/swe-01/sum.js so the behavior above holds.
title: Fix off-by-one in sum()
